title: Bare Bones x Snowy Spirit
description: Bare Bones textures for Snowy Spirit mod ! 🛷
body:
![Bare Bones x Snowy Spirit logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86063020a1711da5829d6259a3e565fadb262ce3.png)
-----------

This resource pack adds Bare Bones textures to [Snowy Spirit](https://modrinth.com/mod/snowy-spirit) mod !

Lights are also emissive when using shaders !

- I highly recommend using [Bare Bones x Mods](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-x-mods) instead of this pack - It's a more convenient way to use my Bare Bones compatibility packs !
